title: sound
description: What the soundtrack of one video does, heard by an audio-capable model together with the code's sound measurements (hits, levels, how often cuts and movements land on hits). Times are VIDEO seconds.

instrumentation.description: In general terms (sparse piano, plucked strings and soft pads, light percussion). No titles, no artists.

follows_structure.description: How the music changes with the film's segments (drops out at the turn, builds into the payoff), or 'it does not'.

style.description: Realistic, cartoon, musical, minimal... and how loud against the voice.

delivery.description: Tone and register (warm, conversational, measured...). No identification of the speaker.

emphasis.description: How key words are stressed (pitch, a pause before, slowing down).

silence.description: Where the soundtrack goes quiet or drops out, and what that does.

sound_picture_sync.description: Do sounds land on picture events (cuts, arrivals, impacts)? Use the code's cuts_on_hit_share and moves_on_hit_share.

sound_rules.description: Rules this soundtrack follows, testable where possible (e.g. 'music ducks at least 12 dB under the voice').

loom_translation.description: What Loom's synthesised sound and music should do differently to match this, in adult corporate terms.
